name: lucida-app
description: Lucida — test a lesson plan against a simulated classroom before you teach it.

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && (npm run dev -w backend & npm run dev -w frontend)
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w frontend
scripts._comment: shared is consumed as a built package (dist), so it must be compiled before anything type-checks or runs against it.
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
